summary: By decision: new 17 of 20 correct; declined 15 of 15 correct; parallel 14 of 15 correct; extend 15 of 15 correct. The one wrong decision (Matthew 9:20–22 made a new record although AUD-46-8-43 already holds the same healing) and two of the partly-right ones (2 Maccabees 11:13–21 too wide; Hebrews 11:28–40 overlapping linked verses) were corrected before compiling. The third (Numbers 15:13–14 linked to C0857 rather than widening it) is a policy choice, noted under Decisions for the editor.

cases.note: Reported request by Jason's bearers is clearly stated and unrecorded; 4:19 alone is right; Command, speaker and recipient fit.
Ahithophel states what he himself will do (17:1–3); the standard excludes a speaker's own plan. Hushai's directive counsel is recorded separately.
Narrated appointment, in scope (cf. AUD-10-17-25); 9:25 unrecorded; Commission, speaker and recipient right.
Fable belongs with its application (9:15 threat restated in 9:20); parallel avoids overlapping Study Context 9:10, 9:12 and contradicting the record's note.
Creation narrative; nothing directive in Genesis 1:25.
15:13–14 continue C0857's own speech and rule (same speaker, occasion); should be record_extend to 15:3–14, not a parallel.
Acts 13:22 recalls God raising up and attesting David; matches this record's existing Greek Psalm 88:20–21 link.
9:18 introduces the recalled covenant ceremony already linked (9:19–20); rightly drops 9:21 (another rite) and 9:22 (doctrine).
18:5 is part of Joshua's same charge to the surveyors (18:4–6); extending the 18:6 record is apt.
Offering-list narrative; no direction.
Lysias's urging to settle (11:14) is recordable, but 11:13–21 sweeps in narration and a letter of greeting, report and conditional promise; narrow and retitle.
Bystanders' mocking remark; crucifixion taunts are unrecorded in every Gospel, Matthew 27:49 included, so nothing to link.
The Lord's appointment of Jeroboam with stated covenant conditions is unrecorded and distinct from ot-1-kings-v11-31; fields right.
8:13 states what Ezekiel will see; it is not a direction. The 8:9 command is already recorded.
5:1–8 continues 4:16–18 across the chapter break (unseen and eternal; walk by faith, not sight); no other record covers it.
12:35 expressly cites Moses' instruction and 12:36 repeats 11:3; a suitable parallel to torah-exodus-11-1.
Genealogical description; 'summoned' is a title here, not a direction.
Narrator describing priestly custom; the standard excludes it.
The genealogy expressly recalls David's appointment of singers once the ark rested, already recorded at 16:4–7; parallel is right.
Completes Matthew's pericope to match the existing full Mark 12:35–37 and Luke 20:41–44 links.
Same incident already recorded: AUD-46-8-43 (Luke 8:43–48, + Mark 5:25–34). Link Matthew 9:20–22 there as a parallel, not a new record.
Courtesy embassy to the new king; comparable embassies (2 Samuel 5:11, 8:10) are unrecorded. Borderline but defensible.
Judah quotes his 43:9 surety pledge to Joseph; parallel to ot-genesis-v43-8 fits practice (cf. recorded recalls 44:21, 44:25).
Imprecatory prayer addressed to God; out of scope.
Stated request by Judas's men to Scythopolis, unrecorded; speaker, recipient and reference fine (12:30 as setting).
8:18 opens the same quoted word of the Lord to David; a contiguous extension of the 8:19 record is right.
18:32 repeats C0884's 'when you take the firstfruits from it' and adds its sanction; a sensible extension.
The king's compulsion (7:1) and the torturers' renewed demand (7:7) are stated and unrecorded; distinct from the torture order AUD-16-7-3.
Oath-curse banning rebuilding works as a prohibition (cf. Saul's AUD-09-14-24); Law and Mixed origins fit, given 1 Kings 16:34.
The father's further urging to stay; the similar fifth-day urging (19:8) is a sensible parallel target; context accurate.
Narrated appointment of leaders, in scope; unrecorded; fields fine.
Matches the catalogue's individual Exodus 40 records (40:2, 5, 6, 8); the editor rejected the C0275 parallel; fields right.
Diplomatic mission carrying a request, answered by recorded AUD-15-13-36; consistent with AUD-15-12-1.
Rhetorical question with a conditional reward offer; such offers (Judges 1:12, 1 Chronicles 11:6) are unrecorded; Jephthah's enlistment is recorded.
Same command as Numbers 27:12 (Pisgah is Nebo's summit); C0922 already links Deuteronomy 32:49 the same way.
12:19–13:4 lead into 13:5–10, whose 13:10 restates the 13:2 warning; skipping the separately recorded 13:1 is right.
21:19 renews 'strike your hand'; 21:18 bridges and 21:20 completes the sentence; a contiguous extension is fine.
John quotes the Passover bone law; C0101 already links Exodus 12:46 and Numbers 9:12.
Plea for life sent by Ben-hadad (his plan in Saints 21:31); an unrecorded request between recorded 21:31 and 21:33.
16:2 frames the same speech ('saying'); a harmless contiguous extension.
Narrated military dispatch with a stated purpose, recorded elsewhere (AUD-10-10-7, AUD-09-19-11-2); unrecorded here.
Mark 1:7–8 is the proclamation that Acts 19:4 summarizes; a sensible parallel.
A reflection on God's judgment of Egypt (doctrine), not a wisdom saying that directs conduct.
Envoy frame and opening of the same letter, leading into the request; an acceptable extension.
Promise, not a direction.
Narrated errand order to her eunuch (cf. AUD-10-9-1, ot-esther-v4-10); unrecorded; fields right.
Bare reported summons with no stated purpose; the analogous Genesis 41:8 and Daniel 2:2 summonses are unrecorded. Borderline but defensible.
27:8 continues the altar-making instruction ('make it hollow'); C0277 is the right target.
12:25 is the sanction attached to 12:24's charge in the same speech.
An imperative to proclaim, matching recorded Jeremiah 4:5 and 4:16 in type and topic.
Nehemiah's further order in the same rite with the same water; it continues AUD-16-1-20.
6:17 opens the same request as 6:18; the extension is right.
A stated rallying cry, like Sheba's recorded cry (AUD-10-20-1); 1 Kings 12:16 is unrecorded; fields fine.
An 'examples of faith' record fits A072/A073, but 11:29 is already linked to C0121; 11:28 and 11:30 are better as parallels (C0095, Jericho record).
Narrated priestly installation, in scope (cf. ot-judges-v17-10); topic corrected sensibly.
Rhetorical question; 11:30 is already linked to AUD-51-12-7.
50:8 introduces 50:9's command, as AUD-29-39-6 includes its own introduction; a better target than the flagged 39:6.
Restates the one-law principle for the unintentional-sin law; a parallel to C0114, like Numbers 9:14.
The elder's answer continues the linked 7:13–14, restating the beatitude's reward. Borderline (promise) but coherent.
A same-psalm restatement of 36:32–33 (the sinner watches the righteous; the Lord intervenes); a better target than the flagged Sirach record.
1:15 completes Joshua's charge to the eastern tribes; a contiguous extension.
Narrated appointment, in scope (cf. AUD-15-10-65); unrecorded; fields right.
Rhetorical question and prediction; no direction.
An invitation-request to the king; the catalogue records similar invitations (AUD-10-13-24); unrecorded; fields right.
23:12–13 is the warning attached to 23:11 ('For if you turn back'); extending avoids recording an implied prohibition.
